name: Atuin
description: Atuin replaces your shell history with a searchable SQLite database that records context such as exit code, duration and working directory. Its sync server keeps that history end-to-end encrypted and in step across all your machines, so the server never sees your commands in plain text.

notes.text: Registration is closed. Create an account inside the container with `ATUIN_CONFIG_DIR=/opt/atuin_data atuin-server admin user create --email you@example.com you`, or set `open_registration = true` in the config to let clients run `atuin register`.
Set `sync_address = "http://<IP>:8888"` in each client's ~/.config/atuin/config.toml, then `atuin login` and `atuin sync`. Put a TLS reverse proxy in front before exposing it beyond your LAN.
